goal: A new orchestrator WorkGraph, built from WorkItem objects, validates structure on construction (raising WorkGraphValidationError naming duplicate-id / self-dep / cycle members), records missing-prerequisite GraphValidationIssues without raising, and answers ready_set(states, excluded) with exactly the currently-runnable items.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00047-workgraph-validation.md -- the acceptance criteria SC-1..SC-11 this task satisfies, and the D-1 missing-prereq decision
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_sources.py -- WorkItem (task, prerequisites, source_ref, local_path); build the graph FROM these objects

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- select_next_task (lines ~284-330) and TaskState enum (~110-118); ready_set must answer the same eligibility question (prereqs DONE, own state eligible, id not excluded) without changing this function
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_work_graph.py -- the held-out oracle for this task; make it green, do not edit it
references: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_sources.py -- mirror the frozen, kw_only dataclass style for the new value types
constraints: Add a new module under packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/ exposing WorkGraph, GraphValidationResult, GraphValidationIssue, and WorkGraphValidationError; the graph is constructed from a sequence of WorkItem.

Structural corruption hard-fails: duplicate task id, a self-dependency, or a cycle each raise WorkGraphValidationError, and the message must name the offending id(s) -- for a cycle, every participating member id (D-1).

A prerequisite that resolves to no item is NOT a raise: record a GraphValidationIssue naming the referencing task id and the missing prerequisite id on the returned result, and keep that task out of ready_set (D-1).

ready_set(states, excluded) returns every item whose prerequisites are all DONE, whose own state is eligible, and whose id is not in excluded -- and only those; it does not early-return after the first match (parallel children must all surface).
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not add any field to WorkItem and do not touch core flywheel_core.task.Task (it has no prerequisites field and stays input-source agnostic).
Do not add priority ordering, weighting, or a Scheduler.choose -- selection stays deterministic first-eligible (spec 00049, out of scope).
Do not modify files under tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions in the held-out oracle.
Do not aggregate across multiple WorkSources here -- that is the workgraph-builder task; this task constructs a graph from an already-collected WorkItem sequence.
edge_cases: A self-edge (task lists its own id) is a 1-cycle and must raise, not be silently dropped.
A 3-node cycle (a->b->c->a) must name all three members in the error, not only a 2-cycle.
An empty WorkItem sequence builds an empty graph with no issues and an empty ready_set (no crash).
